title: Liouville phenomenon for the Klein-Gordon equation in 1+1 dimensions
summary: We study the Klein-Gordon equation in one spatial and one temporal dimension. Physically, this equation describes the wave function of a relativistic spinless boson with positive rest mass. Mathematically, this is the most elementary hyperbolic partial differential equation, after the wave equation itself. Relative to the origin, the spacetime splits according to the light cones, and we find four quarter-planes, two of which are timelike while the remaining two are spacelike.
